mathematical_repairs.correction: original_rejected belongs to classical tree; local-survive/global-reject belongs to path-occupancy variant; 171/265 and zero-deletion plus CONFIG belongs to shared-z variant. Existing general safety and family-specific actual OPT=2-1/k proof for k>=4 are complete; section5 no longer lists them as open.

contracts_preserved.pDM_complete_actual_NO_escape: Three machines e0=(a1,b1,c1),e1=(a1,b2,c2),e2=(a2,b1,c2); all six vertex jobs time4 at incident edges, four universal dummy jobs time3. Actual e0 has a1,b1,c1 (12), e1 b2,c2+one dummy (11), e2 a2+three dummy (13). If all loads<=12,total36 forces all12; then 4v+3d=12 forces all four dummy on one machine and full vertex triples on two disjoint edges, impossible. Integral lower bound plus complete assignment gives OPT13 at T12.
contracts_preserved.two_sink_parity_actual_load: At T26 the macro fills its home; each sink has 13 forced unit tasks, so item residual13. The six values4,4,4,4,4,6 have no odd subset13, ruling out an integer T26 assignment. Half each item to each sink gives total load13+13=26 per sink. Same original33 jobs throughout; a two-sink item-only calculation is not the whole schedule.
contracts_preserved.filter_general_safety: Prune p>T; big>T/2 and small<=T/2. For forced big(j,i), matching must cover N={jobs without any small endpoint} plus j, maximizing removable unique-small-home weight W_ij. A true T-schedule big edge set is a matching that covers N and realizes all departing unique-home tasks; p_ij+F_i-W_ij<=T. Thus iterations preserve every true T-schedule, while acceptance alone is not sufficient.
contracts_preserved.shared_z_family_and_small_parameter_boun: For k>=4 and its stated height h>=3, original CONFIG at T0=1+1/k survives full necessary filtering after occupancy tasks receive shared z endpoint1/2. If B<2-1/k, tree activation yields at least four distinct terminal groups, each requiring one blocking task on z, whose load>=2>B. Old complete single-path upper assignment avoids z, so OPT=2-1/k. The independently enumerated k2/3,height1 escape inputs have OPT1 and are not counterexamples to this restricted family theorem.
contracts_preserved.convex_price_and_one_heavy_face: tau is convexified/mixed heavy-placement load value; Gamma fixes one integer heavy H then optimizes fractional light flow. A separate best H for every price does not give one H working for all prices. Finite primal=dual fixtures or successful price queries do not solve general common-capacity scheduling.
